01
The Beginning

First Connection

They found each other on Hinge — the way many great love stories begin now, with a small act of courage: a profile, a like, a first message. What followed was a friendly, easy exchange. Nothing dramatic. Just two people discovering that conversation came naturally, and that something felt different about this one.

02
The Call That Changed Everything

One Hour. No Plans.

Then came the call. A spontaneous, unplanned one-hour phone call on a weekend afternoon. No agenda, no performance — just two people talking, losing track of time, and realising they didn’t want to stop. They both still speak about that call the way people speak about their favourite songs: you just know it when you hear it.

03
Three Months Later

Making It Official

Three months later, they made it official. And now, after building something real and beautiful together — across cities, cultures, and time zones — Abiola and Grateful are preparing to make the biggest declaration of all.

04
November 21, 2026

Forever Begins in Lagos

They are choosing each other, forever. A Nigerian-Cameroonian love story, celebrated in Lagos — where two cultures, two families, and two hearts come together as one. And they want you there when they do.

For International Guests

Travel & Stay

For our international family and friends traveling from afar, we’ve prepared thoughtful guidance to make your journey to Lagos seamless.

✈️

Arriving in Lagos

Fly into Murtala Muhammed International Airport (LOS). Major connections via London Heathrow, Dubai, Paris CDG, and Toronto. Allow extra time at immigration on weekends.

🏠

Where to Stay

We recommend Victoria Island (VI), Ikoyi, or nearby parts of Lekki for convenient access to the celebration. Explore the hotel options below and book early.

🚗

Getting Around

Pre-arrange airport pickups through your hotel or a trusted driver. Bolt and inDriver work well across Lagos. Avoid traveling late at night without a pre-arranged driver.

💲

Currency & Cash

The Nigerian Naira (NGN) is the local currency. ATMs are available in major hotels and malls. Always carry some naira cash. Exchange at banks only.

📱

Connectivity

Buy a local SIM at the airport — MTN and Airtel are most reliable. WhatsApp is the primary communication tool for everything in Nigeria.

🌤️

Weather in November

November is the dry season in Lagos — warm, sunny, and far less humid. Expect 26–32°C (79–90°F). Light, breathable fabrics are ideal.

🍽️

Food & Dining

Don’t miss jollof rice, suya, pepper soup, and fresh Atlantic seafood. Victoria Island and Lekki have spectacular restaurants from traditional Nigerian cuisine to fine dining.

🛡️

Safety & Local Tips

Stay in well-known guest areas, travel with trusted companions or pre-arranged drivers, and keep valuables discreet. We’ll send a detailed guide to all confirmed guests.

Good To Know

Wedding FAQ

A few helpful answers before you make your way to Lagos.

Are children invited?

Our wedding celebrations are an adults-only occasion. We kindly ask that children not attend unless otherwise indicated.

Can I bring a plus-one?

Please attend only with any additional guest specifically included with your invitation. Your RSVP should reflect only those invited to celebrate with us.

Are both ceremonies on the same day?

Yes. The White Ceremony begins at 10:30 AM, followed by the Traditional Ceremony at 1:00 PM on Saturday, November 21, 2026.

What should I wear?

The White Ceremony dress code is Black Tie. For the Traditional Ceremony, come in your finest traditional attire. The colour of the day is Light Mint Green.

What time should I arrive?

Please arrive early enough to be seated before each ceremony begins. Lagos traffic can be unpredictable, so we recommend allowing extra travel time.

When is the RSVP deadline?

Please submit your RSVP no later than October 31, 2026.

Where should I stay in Lagos?

Victoria Island, Ikoyi, and nearby parts of Lekki are convenient options. Our recommended hotels are listed above with approximate travel times.

What if my plans change after I RSVP?

Please reach out to us as soon as possible so we can keep our guest and seating arrangements up to date.

Venue Details

The celebration will take place in Lekki, Lagos.

Both ceremonies take place in Lekki. Use the event details and direction links on our Events page to plan your journey, and allow extra travel time for Lagos traffic.
